note: Where every data source of bench/ comes from, under what terms, and what of it is committed. "committed" is in this repository; "fetched" is downloaded by `npm run bench:fetch` into bench/.cache (git-ignored) and checked against the hashes below.
evidenceLabels: Verified = checked by running something; Reported = a source says so; Unknown = not checked.

sources.name: RAGTruth
sources.license: MIT (Verified: LICENSE in the repository, copyright 2023 Particle Media; GitHub reports MIT). The repository states no separate data license.
sources.whatItIs: 17,790 real responses from six language models to question answering, news summary and data-to-text prompts, with annotators' span-level hallucination labels.
sources.sourceTexts: The prompts' source texts come from MS MARCO passages (QA), CNN and Daily Mail articles (summary) and Yelp business records (data-to-text). Their own terms apply and were not reviewed (Unknown).
committed: bench/data/ragtruth-field.jsonl and bench/data/ragtruth-holdout.jsonl: for each chosen response, the model's answer, the annotators' span offsets, facts derived from the source (which digit runs of the answer the source has; for data-to-text a review count, star values and the minutes of the opening hours), and for question answering and summaries only, number-centered excerpts of the source (48 characters either side of every digit).
bench/data/numbers-203.jsonl: 38 RAGTruth items (answers, labels, number-centered excerpts of the passages).
sources.notCommitted: Full source texts. Data-to-text (Yelp) evidence is not committed at all, not even excerpts. Items that need it run only after `npm run bench:fetch`.
sources.verification: Sizes of both files were compared with the pinned URLs' content-length headers (Verified). The hashes are those of the copies the field trial used; re-downloading to compare them was NOT_RUN in this stage (no download was made).

sources.name: FinanceBench open-source sample
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 per the Hugging Face dataset card PatronusAI/financebench (Reported). The GitHub repository has no license file (Verified: GitHub reports none). Non-commercial terms, so nothing from it is committed here.
sources.whatItIs: 150 questions about public-company filings and 2,400 model completions labeled Correct, Incorrect or Refusal by humans, with the filing pages the annotators used as evidence.
sources.notCommitted: Everything: no text, answers, labels or page excerpts. Only published aggregate numbers (README, bench/METHOD.md) come from it.
sources.verification: Sizes of all 17 files were compared with the pinned URLs' content-length headers (Verified). The hashes are those of the copies the field trial used; re-downloading to compare them was NOT_RUN in this stage.

sources.name: TAT-QA
sources.license: Dataset: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (Reported: the repository README). Repository code: MIT (Verified: GitHub reports MIT).
sources.whatItIs: Question answering over financial report tables and paragraphs.
committed: bench/data/numbers-203.jsonl: 147 items built from TAT-QA table rows and paragraphs (answers are written by the benchmark generator; the evidence is the table row or paragraph text). Changes: rows reformatted into evidence chunks, answers composed from the gold derivation, errors planted by programmatic edits. Attribution in bench/NOTICE.md.

sources.name: FinQA
sources.license: MIT (Verified: LICENSE in the repository, copyright 2021 Zhiyu Chen). The text inside the tables comes from public company earnings reports; the repository license does not speak to that text (Unknown).
sources.whatItIs: Numerical reasoning over financial report tables.
committed: bench/data/numbers-203.jsonl: 18 items built from FinQA table rows with the gold derivations.

holdoutDrawn: RAGTruth train split, seed 20261014 (bench/build/select-holdout.mjs). The kit has not been run on, or tuned against, that split before the labels were frozen (bench/data/FROZEN-holdout.sha256).
